event.description:
We are happy to announce that we will be hosting the Radiant Origins Regionals!

Date: June 6, 2026
Check-in time: 9.30
Event Start: 10.30
PLAYER CAPACITY: 100

Regionals are Swiss-style tournaments where top finishers earn Nationals Qualifier Cards which are worth 3 Nationals Qualifier Points toward 2026 Nationals events! 

If you participate you will receive the following:
1 Radiant Origins Event Pack
2 Radiant Origins Booster Pack
1 Exclusive Regional Dragon Shield Sleeves (blind box - one of four art variants!)
1 Radiant Origins Sapphire Pack - a Regionals-exclusive pack containing a single foil card from Re:Collection: Aurelian Regent. These foils exist NOWHERE else!

Top 16 finishers will receive the following
🏅 Nationals Qualifier Card - a stunning new art of Infinite Scintillation featuring Merlin!
🏅 Cleansing Reunion Finalist Playmat - awarded to all NQ Card earners!
🏅 Shared Fervor Champion Playmat for 1st Place!

Come and register before June 1st!  We have an early bird promo!


Mark your calendars and get ready to battle in June! 💥
